findingsReportedNotFixed.title: A launched match leaves BOTH surfaces permanently at `pending`, masking live/sealed/finalized for the whole match.
findingsReportedNotFixed.owner: finding recorded in the unit ledger; fix owner unassigned. No roadmap node owns src/lib/multiplayer/client.ts or the lobby component, so assigning one would widen the program's ownership map - an owner call, not an agent call.
findingsReportedNotFixed.measured: 20s at launch and 25s across a full close/reconnect cycle, both host and guest, posture `pending` at every one-second sample, banner reading 'Your command is awaiting the match server.'
findingsReportedNotFixed.rootCause: the lobby Ready control dispatches a real `SetReady` Intent (src/components/multiplayer/LobbyPanel.tsx:141-147); every sent intent is remembered in `pendingIntents` (client.ts:1336); and an intent is settled ONLY by an Event whose payload.intentId matches (client.ts:349-352) or an Error carrying it (client.ts:394). The server answers SetReady with LobbyUpdated, which is neither, so the entry is never removed. `pending` (precedence 7) then outranks live (10), sealed (8) and finalized (9).
findingsReportedNotFixed.consequenceForPlayers: every player who clicks Ready is told for the entire match that a command is awaiting the server, while the command gate does NOT refuse `pending` - so the surface is fully playable while permanently announcing an unresolved command.
findingsReportedNotFixed.whatTheRowDoesAboutIt: reloads once after launch and says why at the call site. `pendingIntents` is per-client (constructed empty at client.ts:607), so a fresh document has no carry-over, and reloading a live match is an ordinary player action. Measured after the reload: both surfaces report `live`. The parent's ruling is to keep this launch path.
findingsReportedNotFixed.notFixed: the fix is in src/, which this unit does not own.

findingsReportedNotFixed.title: `npm run build` exits 1 in a junction-node_modules worktree even though the compile succeeds.
findingsReportedNotFixed.message: {"ok": false, "error": "Unsafe hydration destination (runtime loader tsx) contains a symlink or junction: .next\\standalone\\node_modules"}
findingsReportedNotFixed.impact: none on this unit's proof path - the ladder runner launches `node server.js`, which takes the standalone path only when server.next-config.json sits beside it (server.js:35-46), and that file is absent here.
findingsReportedNotFixed.trap: the build's EXIT CODE cannot be used as the success signal in this worktree, and a `npm run build | tail` pipeline hides that by reporting tail's status. Success is read from the artifacts instead: the Route (pages) table printed, .next/standalone/server.js present at 7325 bytes, and __E2E_MODE__ present in the app chunk.
